note: Recorded re-stage (the 1.5 driver's own documented prep): fpsync -n 16 /mnt/weka/data/tcga-brca/ -> local NVMe fpsync-source. WHY: 1.5 measures local->filesystem writes, so the corpus must pre-exist on the fast local source; 6.C/7.5's ingest workloads read the same staged source. A staging pass, not a comparison cell (na-staging-prep); mount is idle (nothing in flight).

cost_inputs.basis: infra-only = instance+filesystem; all-in = instance+filesystem+software. Both computed per cell (D7). The Lustre software rate is 0 because the FSx service rate is software-inclusive; the WEKA software rate is the public AWS Marketplace rate, dated like every price.
